notes.title: pureya gives you a mini-game that changes every 10 seconds
notes.content:
What if you combined a bunch of small arcade games into something that changes every 10 seconds? pureya answers that question with over 30 small games you can unlock.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/pureya-gives-you-a-mini-game-that-changes-every-10-seconds
